title: pseudoconyza viscosa
intro: Pseudoconyza viscosa, commonly known as sticky fleabane, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pseudoconyza viscosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
